outcomes.outcome: Configure and Execute Automated Test Runs
outcomes.description: Select test parameters, provide optional OIDC credentials, initiate runs, monitor live log output, and control in-progress executions (stop or force-reset).

scenarios.scenario: Configure test parameters and initiate a test run
scenarios.description: QA Engineer selects a test scenario, target browser, and headless preference, optionally supplies OIDC session credentials with client-side JSON validation, and submits the run. Invalid OIDC JSON aborts the run immediately. On success the server spawns Playwright and the live log console begins populating.

steps.step: Specify the test scenario and browser settings

actions.description: label: Test Scenario; type: enum; required: true; default: Breezeai sanity dev; options: Breezeai sanity dev, Breezeai sanity prod, Breezeai complete regression dev, AccionConnect sanity dev, AccionConnect sanity prod; disabled while a run is in progress
label: Browser; type: enum; required: true; default: chromium; options: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit; passed as --project flag to Playwright CLI; disabled while a run is in progress
label: Run in headless mode; type: boolean; default: false (headed mode); when false --headed flag appended to Playwright CLI args; disabled while a run is in progress

actions.action: Indicate whether to show the Authentication section
actions.description: Toggles visibility of OIDC Key and OIDC Value fields; label alternates Hide/Show; defaults to shown; both fields disabled when section is hidden

label: OIDC Key; type: text; required: false; placeholder: oidc.user:...; copied from browser DevTools Application > Session Storage; forwarded as OIDC_KEY env var; disabled while a run is in progress or section hidden

label: OIDC Value (JSON); type: JSON textarea; required: false; must be valid JSON if provided; parsed by JSON.parse before submit -- invalid JSON aborts run and shows error below field; forwarded as OIDC_VALUE env var; disabled while a run is in progress or section hidden

actions.action: Indicate whether to mask the OIDC value display
actions.description: label: Mask OIDC value; type: boolean; default: false; when enabled textarea replaced with read-only bullet-character field; Reveal affordance restores editable view; only active when Authentication section visible

Validates OIDC Value as JSON client-side; aborts if invalid; sends testScenario, browser, headless, oidcKey (optional), oidcValue (optional parsed JSON) to server; server rejects HTTP 409 if run already in progress

apis.request: {testScenario: string, browser: string, headless: boolean, oidcKey?: string, oidcValue?: object}
apis.response: {success: boolean, logs: string[], reportAvailable: boolean, customReportAvailable: boolean, customReportPath: string|null}

scenarios.scenario: Monitor test execution via live logs and run status
scenarios.description: While a test run is in progress the QA Engineer observes timestamped log entries in the live console, a color-coded run status badge, and the active run context summary. The application polls the server every 3 seconds to reconcile final run completion state.

actions.description: Timestamped log lines in a monospace console with dark background; auto-scrolls to latest entry; shows: No test logs yet. Configure and run a test to begin. when empty; shows: Running -- logs will appear here... while initialising
Color-coded badge showing current run state: IDLE (grey), RUNNING (amber), PASSED (green), FAILED (red), STOPPED (red); badge text is runStatus value in uppercase
Subtitle line below the Live Test Logs heading showing the selected scenario, browser, and headed or headless mode; reflects current state variables regardless of whether a run is active

steps.step: Poll server for updated run status

actions.description: Executed automatically every 3 seconds while testInProgress is true; updates customReportAvailable and customReportPath; when testRunInProgress becomes false on server the UI transitions to completed state

apis.response: {testRunInProgress: boolean, currentChildPid: number|null, customReportAvailable: boolean, customReportPath: string|null, lastCustomReportDebug: object|null}

scenarios.description: QA Engineer stops an in-progress test run. A confirmation prompt prevents accidental stops. The stop signal is sent to the server which terminates the Playwright process tree; the client simultaneously aborts the fetch via AbortController. Run status transitions to STOPPED.

actions.description: Confirmation prompt: Stop test execution? This will attempt to cancel the running test. Stop request only sent if user confirms; declining leaves run in progress; available only while testInProgress is true

steps.step: Submit the stop request to the server

actions.description: Sends stop signal to server to terminate Playwright process tree; client also aborts in-flight run request via AbortController; server responds with success and a message string
Brief notification shown after stop attempt; e.g. Stop signal sent to server. on success, Stop request failed or timed out. on failure; auto-dismisses after 5 seconds; run status updates to STOPPED

scenarios.scenario: Reset server run state when stuck
scenarios.description: When the server is in an inconsistent state the QA Engineer force-resets the run. A confirmation prompt warns that this will kill any running test. On success all run flags are cleared and the UI returns to idle.

steps.step: Confirm the server run state reset

actions.description: Confirmation prompt: Reset run state on server? This will attempt to kill any running test and clear UI state. Reset only sent if user confirms; declining leaves current state unchanged

actions.action: Submit the server run state reset
actions.description: Sends force-reset request to server; server kills any running Playwright process and clears testRunInProgress and currentChild flags; on success UI returns to idle state
Brief notification shown after reset; e.g. Run state reset. on success, or error string on failure; auto-dismisses after 5 seconds; run status updates to STOPPED; log entry appended to console

outcomes.description: View or download the test report generated by a completed run. A custom HTML report is shown preferentially; otherwise the standard Playwright HTML report is offered.

scenarios.scenario: Open the available test report after a run completes
scenarios.description: After a test run finishes the QA Engineer reviews which report type was generated and opens it in a new browser tab. Custom HTML report takes priority; otherwise the Playwright HTML report is offered; contextual messages explain when neither is available.

steps.step: Observe report availability status after run completion

actions.description: Shown when customReportAvailable is true after a run completes; indicates a custom HTML report was generated by parsing Playwright JSON reporter output; action to open the custom report becomes available
Shown when reportAvailable is true and customReportAvailable is false after a successful run; indicates the standard Playwright HTML report exists at playwright-report/index.html

Shown when run completed but no report generated: displays No report found due to script failure. when testFailed is true, or No report available for this run. when processCompleted is true but neither report available

Opens the custom HTML report in a new browser tab; available when customReportAvailable is true; report shows summary (total, passed, failed, skipped, duration, scenario, browser), failed-tests section, and per-test table with Test, Result, Duration, Browser, Steps, Details columns

apis.response: HTML file -- custom test report from Playwright JSON reporter output; 404 if unavailable

actions.description: Opens the standard Playwright HTML report in a new browser tab; available when reportAvailable is true and customReportAvailable is false; serves playwright-report/index.html; 404 if file does not exist

apis.response: HTML file -- Playwright HTML report at playwright-report/index.html; 404 if not found
